title: docs(skills): name ignore as the seed mode default and the minimal-preset job/queue exception; correct three capability comments
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xMHHsB36x9Uqo5Pp94AzKsu)_

Fixes #31299

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates --tier` reads a contract-review model mandate for `skills/**` (clause ①). That mandate is waived by the maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03). This card ran on the project's default model, and the dispatching seat (domain:skills#3) runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：平台技能 § Seed Data 把 `mode` 的默认值从 `upsert` 改为 `ignore`；§ `requires:` 说明 `--preset minimal` 在有 `email`、`approvals` 或 `auth` 时仍保留 `job` 和 `queue`。自动化技能 DocuSign 评测用例 1 的 `expected_output` 不再含它自己禁止的 `connector-esign`，回调写成 `type: 'api'` 流程，并按技能所教用 `config.signature` 校验 DocuSign Connect 自己的签名头。另外三处只改注释：spec 里 `package-registry` 的说明、`os serve` 里 `requires: ['mcp']` 那一句、`app-showcase` 的注释；`app-showcase` 的 `requires` 去掉常开的 `messaging` 和 `job`。
- 为什么改：这六处与 `main` 的代码不符，会教代理错误的默认值和过时的“需要显式开启”读法（#31299，来自 #31297 契约复核的“其他位置”）。
- 风险与回滚：不改行为。技能文字、一条评测用例和注释；`app-showcase` 少列两个常开能力，默认预设下照样挂载。平台 SKILL.md 删掉 Turso 行里重复的一句来付字节，净 -40 字节（5994 / 6011 tokens），不动棘轮。发版 `@objectstack/skills` patch；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L296 与 L366；然后 `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json` 用例 1。
- 两分钟验证：对照 `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts` L207（`SeedMode.default('ignore')`）和 `packages/core/src/capability-composition.ts` L86、L135–L138（`NEEDS_JOB_AND_QUEUE`）读两行；`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`（平台 5994 / 6011）。
- 需要你做的：批准。`check-governed-merges` 判为 Tier H（`skills/**`），需 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 批准；契约复核全量 PASS 6717563682、增量 PASS 6717774623（`Head-sha` `1ff1c115`），席位已 ACCEPT。

## The six sites, before and after

| # | Site | Before | After | Proof on `main` `e2e6ec7dc` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L366, § Seed Data | `upsert` named as the `mode` default | `ignore` named as the default; all five modes still listed (byte-neutral swap) | `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts` L207 `mode: SeedMode.default('ignore')`; `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` § Import modes already says `ignore` (default) |
| 2 | same file L296, § `requires:` | "`--preset minimal` drops exactly those" | "`--preset minimal` drops them; `email`, `approvals` or `auth` keeps `job` and `queue`" | `packages/core/src/capability-composition.ts` L86 `NEEDS_JOB_AND_QUEUE = ['email', 'approvals', 'auth']`, L130-L138: the slate is skipped under `minimal`, then `job` and `queue` are put back when any of those tokens is present; its callers are `serve.ts` L3016, `verify/src/required-providers.ts` L138 and `cli/src/utils/schema-migration-plugins.ts` L2012 |
| 3 | `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json` case 1 | `expected_output` used the forbidden `connector-esign` and lacked the required `type: 'api'`; it also named a "gap" (Connect's own header unverified, status polled) | "not a new connector package"; "a `type: 'api'` flow with a start-node `secretRef`, and its `config.signature` names DocuSign Connect's own header (…), so status changes arrive verified instead of polled"; the gap sentence is gone. Assertions unchanged | `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` L364 ("Vendor-signed: `config.signature` replaces it (recipe 4)"), L419-L420; `references/integration-recipes.md` L130-L133 (the `X-DocuSign-Signature-1` block); `packages/spec/src/automation/api-trigger-signature.test.ts` L86 |
| 4 | `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts` L385-L392, the `'package-registry'` slate note | "That registry keys `marketplace`, not this token, so under `objectstack serve` this entry is inert until the runtime half … lands" | the CLI mounts it through `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` (`@objectstack/core`), which keys this token at `PackageServicePlugin`, the provider the spec row declares and the same one `marketplace` resolves to; a stock boot mounts it, one instance when `marketplace` is also declared | `packages/core/src/capability-providers.ts` L174-L178 (`'package-registry'` row) and L164-L173; `serve.ts` L5161-L5167 (`resolverMounted`); `capability-composition.ts` L130-L133. Comment only |
| 5 | `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` L3002 | "Explicit `requires: ['mcp']` in config works regardless of the env var." | "Explicit `requires: ['mcp']` still mounts the plugin, but with the env var off the route is not served: `isMcpServerEnabled()` alone decides it." (an authenticated caller gets 404; an anonymous one is refused with 401 first, `mcp.ts` L107-L110) | `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` L112-L114 (404 whenever `isMcpServerEnabled()` is false); `core/src/capability-providers.ts` L154-L158 (a declared `mcp` mounts `MCPServerPlugin`); CHANGELOG "New single decision point `isMcpServerEnabled()`" (`packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md` L42383). Comment only |
| 6 | `examples/app-showcase` | `objectstack.config.ts` L95-L101 described `messaging` and `job` as needed, L109 listed both; `src/automation/flows/index.ts` L163-L165, L423, L647 told the reader to install them | the two bullets are gone, a comment above `requires` says both are always-on, that a `--preset minimal` boot drops `messaging` and drops `job` only when `email`, `approvals` or `auth` is absent (this app declares `approvals`), and to list there what it drops, and both entries are removed from `requires`; the three flow comments say the same | `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts` `PLATFORM_ALWAYS_ON_CAPABILITIES`; `capability-composition.ts` L130-L133 |

Case 3, in diff form (one JSON line, shown as the changed phrases):

```diff
-A declarative instance inside the app, not a platform plugin and not a `connector-esign` family:
+A declarative instance inside the app, not a platform plugin and not a new connector package:
-the callback is an `api` flow with a start-node `secretRef`.
+the callback is a `type: 'api'` flow with a start-node `secretRef`, and its `config.signature` names DocuSign Connect's own header (`signs: 'body'`, `header: 'X-DocuSign-Signature-1'`, `algorithm: 'hmac-sha256'`, `encoding: 'base64'`), so status changes arrive verified instead of polled.
- One gap is named plainly: DocuSign Connect signs its own header, which the `api` door does not verify, so status is polled until vendor schemes are verified.
```

After the edit every `must_contain` entry is in the case's `expected_output` and no `must_not_contain` entry is. The `must_not_contain` list keeps `connector-esign` unchanged, so the case still fails an answer that proposes that package. The gap sentence was removed because the skill now teaches the opposite: a vendor-signed callback is verified through `config.signature`, and recipe 4 gives DocuSign's own header as the example. No assertion was added for the signature block, since the prompt does not name the header.

## `app-showcase`: entries removed, and why

`messaging` and `job` are on `PLATFORM_ALWAYS_ON_CAPABILITIES`, so every boot the example is served under (`os dev` / `os serve`, default preset, as in CI's e2e job) mounts both whether listed or not. The platform skill teaches listing them only under `--preset minimal` (`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` L351). Nothing else reads the example's `requires` list: no example test, `e2e`, `qa` or `scripts` file reads it (grep for `.requires`, `'messaging'`, `'job'`), and no dogfood test boots the example under `--preset minimal`. The one effect of dropping a declared token is that a missing provider would warn instead of failing boot. Both providers are dependencies of `@objectstack/cli` (`packages/cli/package.json` L94, L96), so that cannot happen here. The example's tests and typecheck were run after the change (Gates).

## Token readings (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, tokens = ceil((bytes − 20) / 4))

| File | `main` `e2e6ec7dc` | This PR | Ceiling |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` | 24034 B = 6004 | 23994 B = 5994 | 6011 (unchanged) |

- Site 1: 0 B (two mode names swap places).
- Site 2: +47 B.
- **Deletion (-87 B):** the Turso row of § Driver Selection Guide (L206) loses " — ships with the ObjectStack cloud / enterprise distribution, not the open framework". Fact it held: Turso ships only in the cloud / enterprise distribution, not the open framework. Surviving homes: the same cell's "**Cloud / EE only**" and its next sentence ("The open-core CLI recognizes `libsql://` URLs but **fails loudly**"), and `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` L152 (`driver-turso` (**cloud / EE only**)). § Driver Selection Guide is not registered in `check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs` or `check-skill-top-level-keys.mjs`, and no script or test greps the cut text.

Net -40 B. No remainder, so `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is untouched. No rewrap: every untouched line is byte-identical to `main`. L333 (`auth` implies `email`) and L338 (pair `triggers` with `job` under minimal) stay true and are not restated: under `minimal`, `triggers` alone still mounts no `job`.

The case-3 sentence removal is the seat's ruling (no objection, 2026-11-08): it sits inside case 1, and the skill now teaches `config.signature` verification (`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` L364, `references/integration-recipes.md` L130-L133).

## Deviations

- should-fix from review 6717563682 applied in 1ff1c115 (two comments)

## Sweep

- `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/` and `skills/objectstack-data/` for a seed `upsert` default: none. `objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` § Import modes and the generated `content/docs/references/data/seed.mdx` already say `ignore` (default).
- `skills/**` for "drops exactly" or another unqualified minimal-preset claim: `objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` case 3 says "Only a `--preset minimal` boot drops them" of `job` and `messaging`. Its prompt involves no `email`, `approvals` or `auth`, so it stays true; left alone. The case at L340 (`storage`, `settings`) is outside the exception.
- `skills/**` and every eval for `connector-esign`: only the case fixed here.
- Tests, ADRs and docs for a claim that an explicit `requires: ['mcp']` serves the route with the env flag off: none. `content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx` L542 already says the 404 means the surface is disabled. So item 5 stays a comment fix, not a `domain:server` card.
- No generator emits the spec note: it is a `//` comment inside the array, not a TSDoc block, and no file under `content/docs/` carries its old text. `check:docs` and `check:skill-refs` exit 0.

## Other sites found (not edited)

- `packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts` L348, the TSDoc of `PLATFORM_ALWAYS_ON_CAPABILITIES`: "`objectstack serve --preset minimal` opts out entirely". That is true of the slate but leaves out the `job` / `queue` put-back of `NEEDS_JOB_AND_QUEUE`. It is outside this card's one-comment surface.

## Changeset

`.changeset/platform-skill-seed-default-minimal-preset.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`. No `@objectstack/spec` or `@objectstack/cli` entry: their edits are comments only, `Check Changeset` counts changesets per PR (one is present), and AGENTS.md § Post-Task Checklist step 3 asks for one for a change that publishes behaviour. `examples/app-showcase` is `private`.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 103 commands against merge base `e2e6ec7dc`. All 103 ran on head `0ab1aaaa`, and again, re-derived identical, on head `1ff1c115` (the contract review's should-fix, two comment edits) after a full `pnpm build` (exit 0), under `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`: **103 × exit 0, 0 NOT MEASURED** among the listed commands. The CI-only families dispatch-gates names as not locally measurable (shard attestation, Build Core steps, type-check lanes, dogfood jobs) are left to CI. Per-command records: project files `card-31299/gates-0ab1aaaa.txt` and `card-31299/gates-1ff1c115.txt` (the latter also carries `example-showcase` and `cli` typecheck, exit 0).

The order's named checks: `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-refs` and `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (platform 5994 / 6011) are in that list and exit 0. Run beside it, since dispatch-gates derives no test family for these paths:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase run typecheck` :: exit 0
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase test` :: exit 0 (544 passed)
